title: Step and description vector record
description: One language-neutral conformance fixture: a step list or a description, and whether it is accepted, rejected by its JSON Schema, or rejected by the structure rules with a reason and a step position. See the README beside this schema.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case id. Matches the file name stem.

description.description: One sentence stating what the vector proves.

schema.description: `steps` checks `input` against steps.schema.json and then the structure rules. `description` checks it against description.schema.json and then the structure rules on its `steps`, when they are a list, its caveats and its gaps.

input.description: The step list or description under test.

oneOf.description: The JSON Schema rejects the input.
The input passes its JSON Schema and breaks a structure rule of the step list or, for a description, of its caveats, gaps and drawn values.

reason.description: The rule the step list breaks. The vocabulary is StepsErrorReason.

step.description: 0-based position of the step that breaks the rule, or null for a rule on the whole list or on a caveat or gap.
